name: ceh-blog-and-seo
description: CEH blog and SEO: tell people about what you built. Blog posts in a personal, series-first voice, drafted from an idea via structured interview or from notes, edited, and repurposed for Twitter/X, LinkedIn, TL;DR, and newsletters. And discoverability for anything exposed to the internet: technical SEO/GEO for public web pages (meta tags, structured data, sitemap, rendering strategy), the llms.txt agent index, and findability of public-facing text (README first screen, package descriptions and keywords, repo topics, landing copy).
